shared_elements: solar disc in the lunette at the apex
human figures in profile in the upper register
registers of the same hieroglyphic sign-script
many long horizontal lines of text filling most of the surface
oval cartouche-like enclosures around sign groups
raised/incised outline figures with schematic proportions
offering or ritual scene above text
justification: Both are arched fields with a solar disc crowning a small figural scene of profile human figures in the lunette, beneath which the entire remaining surface is filled with ruled horizontal lines of the same distinctive hieroglyphic script including cartouche-shaped enclosures — a highly specific and conventional shared scheme. The chief difference in content is the upper scene: A shows two large adoring figures beneath a disc with radiating hands over an offering table, while B shows a winged disc above a row of many small equal-sized standing figures in a single register.
